messages:
diana: Quick RFC follow-up: ops/eval want a tiny, audited telemetry contract + compatibility rules for FP8/INT8/4-bit profiles. We should avoid ambiguous names and add a schema_version field.

omar: Agreed. Minimal 100% path: schema_version, request_id, model, model_version, precision_profile_id (immutable GUID), precision_profile_label (human), degradation_score, mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, prompt_fp (sha256).

lucy: Add a compatibility_hint: fallback_profile_id and fallback_reason. Runtime must include fallback_profile_id so we never invent fallbacks on the fly.

kyle: Sampling plan: 100% get aggregates (mean_abs_delta, top_k_mismatch_rate). Sampled N% include per_layer_mean_abs and per_layer_std. When sampled include sample_rate so analytics can reweight.

diana: Good. Also include tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd (can be zero if unknown). We need a composite metric name: quality_cost_index to gate promotions; default formula in RFC appendix.

omar: Runtime override ownership: control plane issues rollouts and preferred_profile. Runtime can perform emergency_fallback only if control_plane_unreachable AND (gpu_mem_pct>95 OR worker_ooms>0) AND degradation_score < 0.015. Two-window hysteresis required before action.

lucy: Add an audit_log_id emitted when runtime overrides so ops can trace which control-plane change triggered it. Also runtime must emit reason_code (e.g., MEM_PRESSURE, HIGH_LATENCY, CP_UNREACHABLE).

kyle: Canary policy: start at 0.25% traffic with 100% shadow per-layer sampling for canary buckets. Auto-rollback if quality_cost_index worsens >0.07 for 3min OR median degradation_score >0.05 for 2 windows. Promote above 1% requires human signoff.

diana: Also define profile_stability_tag (stable|experimental|deprecated) to prevent accidental promotion of experimental profiles. Profiles must declare compatible_model_architectures to avoid applying an int8 profile to unsupported model variants.

omar: Privacy: never emit prompt text. Emit prompt_fp and prompt_redacted boolean. If a customer enables full prompt logging, require explicit consent and a separate audited retention policy. Default telemetry retention 21 days, extension requires legal review.

quant-bot: "RFC follow-up: schema_versioned telemetry + compatibility hints + emergency_fallback constraints captured. Action items: @omar write yaml schema, @lucy add fallback_profile_id invariant, @kyle author canary knobs, @diana update RFC appendix." :white_check_mark:
